title: Mathematics Practice Test 1 - Mathematics - Number Theory
subject: Mathematics

questions.q: Lavonne purchased some tickets and snack vouchers for an upcoming event and gave them to the members of her work group. Each member of her work group received the same number of tickets and the same number of snack vouchers. The total number of tickets she gave to her group was 30, and the total number of snack vouchers was 75. Which of the following could be the number of members in Lavonne's work group?
questions.explain: The number of members must be a common divisor of both 30 and 75, as the items were divided equally. The greatest common divisor of 30 and 75 is 15. The other options are not factors of both numbers.

questions.q: On the real number line, how many integers are between $-\frac{65}{6}$ and $\frac{75}{2}$?
questions.explain: First, convert the improper fractions to mixed numbers or decimals. $-\frac{65}{6} = -10\frac{5}{6} \approx -10.83$ and $\frac{75}{2} = 37.5$. The integers strictly between these values range from -10 to 37. To find the number of integers in this range, calculate the difference between the endpoints and add 1 (since both are inclusive in the count): $37 - (-10) + 1 = 37 + 10 + 1 = 48$.
